verdict.rationale: uv supports pinning a Python version to a checked-in .python-version file via `uv python pin`, which is respected by CI and other tooling, and tool/dependency versions are tracked in pyproject.toml/uv.lock for per-project reproducibility. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of cross-machine .python-version switching behavior and edge cases (community evidence is mostly about speed/pip-replacement, not this specific workflow).
